description: Optional, host-neutral DAP behavioral scenarios. The selected adapter supplies the harness, model, credentials and invocation protocol.

scenarios.name: greenfield baseline produces traceable records
scenarios.prompt: Run the DAP process for this greenfield architecture request. Establish the requirement baseline, preserve evidence, produce the architecture and decisions, and report the readiness gate.

scenarios.name: brownfield preparation preserves known gaps
scenarios.prompt: Resume DAP preparation for this brownfield architecture. Preserve existing evidence, distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions, record gaps and avoid silently replacing the current baseline.

scenarios.name: interrupted run resumes from checkpoint
scenarios.prompt: Continue the interrupted DAP run from its checkpoint. Do not reset prior accepted records; reconcile the checkpoint revision and report what remains incomplete.

scenarios.name: blocking review prevents readiness
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate this frozen architecture baseline. Report the score and readiness independently, and keep the baseline blocked because the required security review is not approved.

scenarios.name: evaluation reports versions and freshness
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate the frozen greenfield baseline and publish an evidence-linked report. Include framework, schema, rubric, configuration, evaluator and input-manifest versions, then state whether the report is current.
